name: Account sync (apps' data and settings on every device of the owner)
purpose: replicates the tables an app declares account-scoped (powos-app.json "sync": Lights' bridge + room prefs, Keyboard AI's learning) between the owner's enrolled devices through the account store on PowStation (enroll/powos-enroll.py /v1/account/rows, authenticated by this device's own realm token); last writer wins per row by (hlc, device); a revoked device stops at once. Also lists the owner's apps this device lacks. Secrets never go through it (ShellNet.kt + AccountSecrets.kt). A system-tier service (lib/apps/services/powos-account-sync.json); without root powos-noroot-services starts it. docs/REMOTE-POWOS.md section 2.5
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (lib/apps, staged by rooted.sh deploy); without root the APK's assets (prep-app.sh) via powos-noroot-services
autosleep: never: sleeps 30 s between rounds (120 s while PowStation isn't reachable)
